# My own behaviour contract

This is a decoy fixture standing in for a colleague who already has a CLAUDE.md
they care about. INSTALL.ps1 must classify it as `Differs` and offer
`side-by-side` - it must never be overwritten.

## My rules

- Always use tabs, never spaces.
- Never delegate to subagents; I want to see every file read in the transcript.
- Emojis are fine.

These rules deliberately contradict the kit's, so a silent overwrite would be
obvious in the diff.
